_comment: ALL VALUES ARE ASSUMPTIONS for the prototype, not upay figures. Replace with real numbers before claiming ROI.
false_alarm_cost_note: ASSUMPTION: cost of one false alarm = customer friction + analyst/review time. Placeholder; see sensitivity table.
missed_scam_cost: actual BDT amount of each missed scam transaction (taken from data, assumes the money is not recovered)
threshold_note: strict = flag more (lower cut-off). balanced = current model threshold (chosen on validation). lenient = flag less (0.33 sits just under the model's top score plateau; 0.50 would flag nothing because the model never scores above ~0.37).
